content:
The **Flatwoods Lookout** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. [Pub 1] 

This lookout and its surrounding cabins were previously occupied by Puppet Face, a Wastelander and the owner of Cheswick. Puppet Face was in search of Scooter, a friend of theirs that had gone missing. Puppet Face expressed a desire to return to the Wixon Homestead, where they had left Cheswick. [1] By 2103, the area of lookout is occupied by four Settlers.

“This tower offers stunning views of the valley and woods as well as the town of Flatwoods. There’s a small deck and cottage on the premise to ransack too.”— Atlas of Appalachia

This tower contains a locked Explosives Crate at its base. There are several cabins nearby, one of which contains an Acoustic Guitar and the note Come Back To Us.

- Come Back To Us - Note, found in a cabin nearby.
- Potential Recipe - On a picnic table near the lookout tower.

Like other lookouts in Appalachia, "survey area" can be used to find unidentified areas on the map. For example, the Isolated Cabin and Alpine River Cabins can be marked here. These locations will then be revealed on the map, but they still have to be traveled to on foot to enable fast travel.

The Flatwoods Lookout appears in *Fallout 76*.
